---
title: Fusion Energy Neutronics Workshop
---

[![](https://mybinder.org/badge_logo.svg){fig-alt="Binder"}](https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/fusion-energy/neutronics-workshop/HEAD)

A selection of resources for learning fusion neutronics simulations with a
particular focus on [OpenMC](https://openmc.org/), [DAGMC](https://svalinn.github.io/DAGMC/)
and [Paramak](https://paramak.readthedocs.io)

There are accompanying [slide decks](https://fusion-energy.github.io/neutronics-workshop-slides/index.html) that introduce the workshop and its tasks, tailored to different events. See the Workshop slides section for the full day and half day versions.

There is also a [Gather Town](https://gather.town/app/QnHxhg6bPf8KQdii/openmc-workshop) space which is great for working through the workshop with colleagues.

There are several ways to use this resource with local installation (pip, Conda, Mamba) options cloud based options (Binder, Codespaces) both of which let you modify and run the example simulations.

Every task is a Python script with `# %%` cell markers. The pages in this book are
the rendered output of running those scripts, and the same files can be run cell
by cell in Jupyter Lab or VS Code, or straight through with `python`. The
[install pages](docs/install_pip.md) explain how to set this up.

The repository has benefited greatly from user feedback. Please feel free to
raise GitHub [issues](https://github.com/fusion-energy/neutronics-workshop/issues)
or reach out in the [discussions](https://github.com/fusion-energy/neutronics-workshop/discussions)
section if you spot anything that needs fixing or think of an improvement.
Pull requests are very welcome.
